rca_of_issue: No new blocking issue; one minor cosmetic observed (exit-sheet overlaps with summary during finish-await, src: /app/frontend/app/rapid/session.tsx:312). Reproduction: play Rapid Fire, tap rf-exit-button → rf-exit-finish. Expected: exit-sheet dismisses then summary appears. Actual: for ~200-800 ms (finish network await) the exit-sheet backdrop stays visible under/over the summary. Mitigation: gate the exit-sheet visibility on both `exit` AND `!done` AND `!finishing`, or render finish() in two phases (set a `finishing` state, hide sheet, then setDone).
